g.text: RestNotes - editing lease acquisition, renewal and release
NoteLockController maps responses and applies Cache-Control: no-store.
Service transaction proxy commits before an HTTP success is returned.
refresh current grants / roles / archive state
[absent or expired AND no supplied token]
delete old row if present; insert generation
[active lease with different actor or missing token]
require editor / note condition; retain locks
[valid holder OR unlocked with no token]
All operations first retain live access and ETag requirements.
No note version, content history or activity is changed by lease-only actions.
The note mutex serializes missing-row acquisition and takeover across replicas.
Expiry is exclusive; a lost initial token cannot be recovered from GET status.
Revoked holders cannot renew; remaining editors may wait until expiry.
